newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cultus shares jump on offshore oil report.
newsitem.headline: Cultus shares jump on offshore oil report.

text.p: Shares in Cultus Petroleum NL jumped on Thursday after after it reported a potentially big oil field offshore Western Australia.
The shares jumped 35 cents to a record high of A$4.05 after it said new estimates for the Cornea field indicated between 617 million and 2.665 billion barrels of oil were in place.
The Cornea joint venture operator, Royal Dutch/Shell's Shell Development (Australia), previously indicated recoverable reserves of 200-400 million barrels.
By 0315 GMT (1.15 p.m.), Cultus shares were 25 cents up at A$3.95.
"The market was reacting to some good exploration potential," one stockbroker said.
Analysts said it was unclear how much of the oil in place could actually be recovered but that the find was still significant.
Company secretary Sam Russotti, who disclosed the new estimates to Reuters in Wellington, said the recovery rate was likely to be less than 50 percent.
